verdict.rationale: Column documents its own scoping controls. Custom Roles restrict access down to specific bank accounts and transfer types, API keys are bound to sandbox or live mode, and a community comment praises per-account-number ACH permissions and limits. That covers part of the scoped-credential element, but it is unclear whether these controls apply to API credentials or only to dashboard users, and Column never frames this as agent access. missing for 10: documented agent/AI-agent use by name, outbound transfer amount caps on credentials, counterparty allowlists, explicit read-only balance scopes for API keys, independent hands-on corroboration.
